integrity: The all-size claim is proved combinatorially; finite exhaustive checks and independent transfer dynamic programming are supplementary and do not certify an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Odd rim size at least three; zero total magnetization; single graph-edge exchanges only. Weak minima permit zero-energy moves, and no kinetic trapping or sharp entropy constant is claimed.
title: An eleven-rim onset and exact energy spectrum of Kawasaki weak minima on antiferromagnetic wheels
